/-! Row-wise composition of the extracted balancing transitions. The rows
remain symbolic; no 1024-row reduction or finite-field computation occurs.
The source iterator-to-list transport remains an execution obligation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitFoldSteps
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverStep8

def foldSteps {S R : Type} (step : R → S → Result S) : List R → S → Result S
  | [], s => ok s
  | r::rs, s => do let after ← step r s; foldSteps step rs after

theorem foldSteps_congr {S R : Type} (left right : R → S → Result S)
    (same : ∀ r s, left r s = right r s) (rows : List R) (s : S) :
    foldSteps left rows s = foldSteps right rows s := by
  induction rows generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons r rs ih =>
    simp only [foldSteps, same]
    cases h : right r s with
    | fail e => rfl
    | div => rfl
    | ok after => exact ih after

def filteredStep {S R : Type} (add : S → S → Result S)
    (value : R → S) (selected : R → Bool) (r : R) (sum : S) : Result S :=
  if selected r then add sum (value r) else ok sum

theorem m31_row (sum value : aspis_core.field.M31) (active : Bool)
    (row dependent : Usize) :
    prover_commit_reference.balance_m31_step sum value active row dependent =
      (if !active && row != dependent then aspis_core.field.M31.add sum value else ok sum) := by
  cases active <;> by_cases h : row = dependent <;>
    simp [prover_commit_reference.balance_m31_step, h]

theorem qm31_row (sum value : aspis_core.field.QM31) (active : Bool)
    (row dependent : Usize) :
    prover_commit_reference.balance_qm31_step sum value active row dependent =
      (if !active && row != dependent then aspis_core.field.QM31.add sum value else ok sum) := by
  cases active <;> by_cases h : row = dependent <;>
    simp [prover_commit_reference.balance_qm31_step, h]

theorem m31_fold (rows : List Usize) (value : Usize → aspis_core.field.M31)
    (active : Usize → Bool) (dependent : Usize) (sum : aspis_core.field.M31) :
    foldSteps (fun row sum => prover_commit_reference.balance_m31_step
      sum (value row) (active row) row dependent) rows sum =
    foldSteps (filteredStep aspis_core.field.M31.add value
      (fun row => !active row && row != dependent)) rows sum := by
  apply foldSteps_congr
  intro row sum
  exact m31_row sum (value row) (active row) row dependent

theorem qm31_fold (rows : List Usize) (value : Usize → aspis_core.field.QM31)
    (active : Usize → Bool) (dependent : Usize) (sum : aspis_core.field.QM31) :
    foldSteps (fun row sum => prover_commit_reference.balance_qm31_step
      sum (value row) (active row) row dependent) rows sum =
    foldSteps (filteredStep aspis_core.field.QM31.add value
      (fun row => !active row && row != dependent)) rows sum := by
  apply foldSteps_congr
  intro row sum
  exact qm31_row sum (value row) (active row) row dependent

#print axioms foldSteps_congr
#print axioms m31_row
#print axioms qm31_row
#print axioms m31_fold
#print axioms qm31_fold
end R1Z.ProverCommitFoldSteps

/-! The complete extracted owned balancing recursion equals a finite ascending
fold, including all indexing and arithmetic errors. No concrete 1024-row
normalization is used. Kani checks the shipped filter/fold row transition. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitBalanceRecursion
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProverBalance9
open R1Z.ProverCommitFoldSteps (foldSteps)

def rowSequence : Nat → Usize → List Usize
  | 0, _ => []
  | n+1, row => row :: rowSequence n (Usize.wrapping_add row 1#usize)

theorem next_row (row : Usize) (h : row.val < 1024) :
    (Usize.wrapping_add row 1#usize).val = row.val + 1 := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  have bound : 2^32 ≤ UScalar.size .Usize := by
    rw [UScalar.size_def]
    exact Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) System.Platform.le_numBits
  have one : (1#usize).val = 1 := by scalar_tac
  rw [one]
  omega

theorem sequence_ascending (n : Nat) (row : Usize)
    (remaining : row.val + n = 1024) :
    (rowSequence n row).map (fun r => r.val) = List.range' row.val n := by
  induction n generalizing row with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    have hr : row.val < 1024 := by omega
    simp only [rowSequence, List.map_cons, List.range'_succ]
    rw [ih _ (by rw [next_row row hr]; omega), next_row row hr]

def m31ReadStep (table : Slice aspis_core.field.M31) (dependent : Usize)
    (active : Aeneas.Std.Array Bool 1024#usize) (row : Usize)
    (sum : aspis_core.field.M31) : Result aspis_core.field.M31 := do
  let value ← Slice.index_usize table row
  let selected ← Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize active row
  prover_commit_reference.balance_m31_step sum value selected row dependent

def qm31ReadStep (table : Slice aspis_core.field.QM31) (dependent : Usize)
    (active : Aeneas.Std.Array Bool 1024#usize) (row : Usize)

  let value ← Slice.index_usize table row
  let selected ← Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize active row

theorem m31_rows_fold (table : Slice aspis_core.field.M31) (dependent : Usize)
    (active : Aeneas.Std.Array Bool 1024#usize) (n : Nat) (row : Usize)
    (sum : aspis_core.field.M31) (remaining : row.val + n = 1024) :
    prover_commit_reference.balance_m31_rows table dependent active row sum =
      foldSteps (m31ReadStep table dependent active) (rowSequence n row) sum := by
  induction n generalizing row sum with
  | zero =>
    have stopped : ¬ row < 1024#usize := by scalar_tac
    rw [prover_commit_reference.balance_m31_rows]
    simp only [stopped, if_false, rowSequence, foldSteps]
  | succ n ih =>
    have running : row < 1024#usize := by scalar_tac
    have hr : row.val < 1024 := by omega
    rw [prover_commit_reference.balance_m31_rows]
    simp only [running, if_true, rowSequence, foldSteps, m31ReadStep, bind_assoc_eq]
    cases hv : Slice.index_usize table row with
    | fail e => rfl
    | div => rfl
    | ok value =>
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      cases ha : Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize active row with
      | fail e => rfl
      | div => rfl
      | ok selected =>
        simp only [bind_tc_ok]
        cases hs : prover_commit_reference.balance_m31_step sum value selected row dependent with
        | fail e => rfl
        | div => rfl
        | ok after =>
          simp only [bind_tc_ok, lift]
          exact ih _ after (by rw [next_row row hr]; omega)

theorem m31_all_rows (table : Slice aspis_core.field.M31) (dependent : Usize)
    (active : Aeneas.Std.Array Bool 1024#usize) (sum : aspis_core.field.M31) :
    prover_commit_reference.balance_m31_rows table dependent active 0#usize sum =
      foldSteps (m31ReadStep table dependent active) (rowSequence 1024 0#usize) sum :=
  m31_rows_fold table dependent active 1024 0#usize sum (by decide)

    | div => rfl

      | div => rfl

        | fail e => rfl

abbrev p : Nat := 2147483647
abbrev word := BitVec 32
def canonical (x : word) : Prop := x.toNat < p
/-- Literal wrapping mask/subtract projection of field/ct.rs::subtract_p. -/
def subtractP (x : word) : word :=
  x - ((BitVec.ofNat 32 p) &&& (0 - (if p ≤ x.toNat then 1 else 0)))
def add (x y : word) : word := subtractP (x+y)
def sub (x y : word) : word := subtractP (x + BitVec.ofNat 32 p - y)
def decode (x : word) : ZMod p := x.toNat

theorem subtractP_branch (x : word) :
    subtractP x = if p ≤ x.toNat then x-BitVec.ofNat 32 p else x := by
  unfold subtractP
  split <;> simp_all [BitVec.zero_sub,BitVec.neg_one_eq_allOnes]
  rfl
#print axioms subtractP_branch

theorem subtractP_nat (x : word) :
    (subtractP x).toNat = if p ≤ x.toNat then x.toNat-p else x.toNat := by
  rw [subtractP_branch]
  split
  · rename_i h
    rw [BitVec.toNat_sub]
    simp only [BitVec.toNat_ofNat]
    have hx := x.isLt
    omega
  · rfl
#print axioms subtractP_nat

theorem subtractP_canonical (x : word) (hx : x.toNat<2*p) : canonical (subtractP x) := by
  unfold canonical
  rw [subtractP_nat]
  split <;> omega
#print axioms subtractP_canonical

theorem add_nat (x y : word) (hx : canonical x) (hy : canonical y) :
    (add x y).toNat = if p ≤ x.toNat+y.toNat then x.toNat+y.toNat-p else x.toNat+y.toNat := by
  unfold add
  rw [subtractP_nat,BitVec.toNat_add,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show x.toNat+y.toNat<2^32 by unfold canonical p at *; omega)]
#print axioms add_nat

theorem add_canonical (x y : word) (hx : canonical x) (hy : canonical y) :
    canonical (add x y) := by
  unfold canonical
  rw [add_nat x y hx hy]
  unfold canonical at hx hy
  split <;> omega
#print axioms add_canonical

theorem add_decode (x y : word) (hx : canonical x) (hy : canonical y) :
    decode (add x y) = decode x+decode y := by
  unfold decode
  rw [add_nat x y hx hy]
  split
  · rename_i h
    rw [Nat.cast_sub h,Nat.cast_add,ZMod.natCast_self,sub_zero]
  · exact Nat.cast_add _ _
#print axioms add_decode
theorem subtractP_decode (x : word) : decode (subtractP x)=decode x := by
  unfold decode
  rw [subtractP_nat]
  split
  · rename_i h
    rw [Nat.cast_sub h,ZMod.natCast_self,sub_zero]
  · rfl
#print axioms subtractP_decode

theorem sub_input_nat (x y : word) (hx : canonical x) (hy : canonical y) :
    (x + BitVec.ofNat 32 p - y).toNat=x.toNat+p-y.toNat := by
  unfold p at *
  have hs : (x + BitVec.ofNat 32 p).toNat=x.toNat+p := by
    rw [BitVec.toNat_add]
    simp only [BitVec.toNat_ofNat]
    unfold canonical p at hx
    change (x.toNat+2147483647)%4294967296=x.toNat+2147483647
    omega
  rw [BitVec.toNat_sub,hs]
  unfold canonical p at hx hy
  change (4294967296-y.toNat+(x.toNat+2147483647))%4294967296=x.toNat+2147483647-y.toNat
  omega
#print axioms sub_input_nat

theorem sub_canonical (x y : word) (hx : canonical x) (hy : canonical y) :
    canonical (sub x y) := by
  apply subtractP_canonical
  rw [sub_input_nat x y hx hy]
  unfold canonical at hx hy
  omega
#print axioms sub_canonical

theorem sub_decode (x y : word) (hx : canonical x) (hy : canonical y) :
    decode (sub x y)=decode x-decode y := by
  unfold sub
  rw [subtractP_decode]
  unfold decode
  rw [sub_input_nat x y hx hy]
  have hle : y.toNat≤x.toNat+p := by unfold canonical at hy; omega
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hle,Nat.cast_add,ZMod.natCast_self,add_zero]
#print axioms sub_decode

theorem decode_injective (x y : word) (hx : canonical x) (hy : canonical y)
    (h : decode x=decode y) : x=y := by
  apply BitVec.eq_of_toNat_eq
  have hv := congrArg ZMod.val h
  simpa only [decode,ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hx,ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt hy] using hv
#print axioms decode_injective

theorem zero_guard (x : word) (hx : canonical x) (hzero : decode x=0) :
    decide (x≠0)=false := by
  have h : x=0 := decode_injective x 0 hx (by unfold canonical p; decide) hzero
  simp [h]
#print axioms zero_guard
end PV_L2C_M31

def insert (s : BitVec 16) (p : Fin 16) : BitVec 16 := s ||| ((BitVec.ofNat 16 1) <<< p.val)

theorem inserted_bit (s : BitVec 16) (p q : Fin 16) :
    (insert s p).getLsbD q.val=(s.getLsbD q.val || decide (p=q)) := by
  unfold insert
  rw [BitVec.getLsbD_or,BitVec.getLsbD_shiftLeft,BitVec.getLsbD_one]
  by_cases he : p=q
  · subst q
    simp [p.isLt]
  · have hv : p.val≠q.val := fun h => he (Fin.ext h)
    by_cases hl : q.val<p.val
    · simp [he,hl]
    · have hs : q.val-p.val≠0 := by omega
      simp [he,hl,hs]
#print axioms inserted_bit

abbrev Masks := Fin 64 → BitVec 16

def block (p : Fin 1024) : Fin 64 := ⟨p.val/16,by have := p.isLt;omega⟩
def bit (p : Fin 1024) : Fin 16 := ⟨p.val%16,by omega⟩
def contains (m : Masks) (q : Fin 1024) : Bool := (m (block q)).getLsbD (bit q).val

def put (m : Masks) (p : Fin 1024) : Masks :=
  fun b => if b=block p then insert (m b) (bit p) else m b

theorem put_contains (m : Masks) (p q : Fin 1024) :
    contains (put m p) q=(contains m q || decide (p=q)) := by
  by_cases hb : block q=block p
  · simp only [contains,put,hb,if_pos,inserted_bit]
    have he : (bit p=bit q)↔p=q := by
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val hb
      simp only [block] at hv
      simp only [bit,Fin.ext_iff]
      omega
    simp only [he]
  · have hpq : p≠q := by intro h;subst p;exact hb rfl
    simp only [contains,put,hb,if_false,hpq,decide_false,Bool.or_false]
#print axioms put_contains

def pack (rows : List (Fin 1024)) (m : Masks) : Masks := rows.foldl put m

theorem packed_contains (rows : List (Fin 1024)) (m : Masks) (q : Fin 1024) :
    contains (pack rows m) q=(contains m q || decide (q∈rows)) := by
  induction rows generalizing m with
  | nil => simp only [pack,List.foldl_nil,List.not_mem_nil,decide_false,Bool.or_false]
  | cons p rows ih =>
    change contains (pack rows (put m p)) q=_
    rw [ih,put_contains]
    simp [List.mem_cons,eq_comm,Bool.or_assoc]
#print axioms packed_contains
end PV_L2C_PackedMasks

def fold : List word → word → word

theorem fold_canonical (xs : List word) (hxs : ∀ x ∈ xs, canonical x)
    (s : word) (hs : canonical s) : canonical (fold xs s) := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => exact hs
  | cons x xs ih =>
    exact ih (fun x hx => hxs x (by simp [hx])) (add s x)
      (add_canonical s x hs (hxs x (by simp)))

theorem fold_decode (xs : List word) (hxs : ∀ x ∈ xs, canonical x)
    (s : word) (hs : canonical s) :
    decode (fold xs s)=decode s+(xs.map decode).sum := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => simp [fold]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rw [fold,ih (fun x hx => hxs x (by simp [hx])) (add s x)
      (add_canonical s x hs (hxs x (by simp))),add_decode s x hs (hxs x (by simp))]
    simp [add_assoc]

theorem fold_zero_decode (xs : List word) (hxs : ∀ x ∈ xs, canonical x) :
    decode (fold xs 0)=(xs.map decode).sum := by
  rw [fold_decode xs hxs 0 (by unfold canonical p; decide)]
  simp [decode]

theorem negate_decode (xs : List word) (hxs : ∀ x ∈ xs, canonical x) :
    canonical (sub 0 (fold xs 0)) ∧
      decode (sub 0 (fold xs 0))=-(xs.map decode).sum := by
  have hz : canonical 0 := by unfold canonical p; decide
  have hc := fold_canonical xs hxs 0 hz
  exact ⟨sub_canonical _ _ hz hc, by rw [sub_decode _ _ hz hc,fold_zero_decode xs hxs]; simp [decode]⟩
#print axioms negate_decode

def Canonical (q : Q) := ∀ i, canonical (q i)
def zero : Q := fun _ => 0
def addQ (x y : Q) : Q := fun i => add (x i) (y i)
def subQ (x y : Q) : Q := fun i => sub (x i) (y i)

theorem zero_canonical : Canonical zero := by intro i; unfold zero canonical p; decide
#print axioms zero_canonical

theorem add_canonical (x y : Q) (hx : Canonical x) (hy : Canonical y) : Canonical (addQ x y) :=
  fun i => PV_L2C_M31.add_canonical (x i) (y i) (hx i) (hy i)
#print axioms add_canonical

theorem sub_canonical (x y : Q) (hx : Canonical x) (hy : Canonical y) : Canonical (subQ x y) :=
  fun i => PV_L2C_M31.sub_canonical (x i) (y i) (hx i) (hy i)
#print axioms sub_canonical

theorem add_decode (x y : Q) (hx : Canonical x) (hy : Canonical y) :
    decodeQ (addQ x y)=decodeQ x+decodeQ y := by
  funext i
  exact PV_L2C_M31.add_decode (x i) (y i) (hx i) (hy i)
#print axioms add_decode

theorem sub_decode (x y : Q) (hx : Canonical x) (hy : Canonical y) :
    decodeQ (subQ x y)=decodeQ x-decodeQ y := by
  funext i
  exact PV_L2C_M31.sub_decode (x i) (y i) (hx i) (hy i)
#print axioms sub_decode

theorem decode_injective (x y : Q) (hx : Canonical x) (hy : Canonical y)
    (h : decodeQ x=decodeQ y) : x=y := by
  funext i
  exact PV_L2C_M31.decode_injective (x i) (y i) (hx i) (hy i) (congrFun h i)
#print axioms decode_injective

theorem zero_decode : decodeQ zero=0 := by funext i; simp [decodeQ,zero,decode]
#print axioms zero_decode

theorem zero_guard (q : Q) (hq : Canonical q) (hz : decodeQ q=0) :
    decide (q≠zero)=false := by

/-- The inactive row sequence split at the dependent cell. This is the exact
final store of balance_m31_copy_inactive, retaining native row order. -/
def rebalance (before after : List word) : List word :=
  before ++ sub 0 (fold (before++after) 0) :: after

theorem rebalance_canonical (before after : List word)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ before, canonical x) (ha : ∀ x ∈ after, canonical x) :
    ∀ x ∈ rebalance before after, canonical x := by
  have hc : ∀ x ∈ before++after, canonical x := by
    intro x hx
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx|hx
    · exact hb x hx
    · exact ha x hx
  intro x hx
  rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx|hx
  · exact hb x hx
  · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl|hx
    · exact (negate_decode _ hc).1
    · exact ha x hx
#print axioms rebalance_canonical

theorem rebalance_decode_sum (before after : List word)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ before, canonical x) (ha : ∀ x ∈ after, canonical x) :
    ((rebalance before after).map decode).sum=0 := by
  have hc : ∀ x ∈ before++after, canonical x := by
    intro x hx
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hx with hx|hx
    · exact hb x hx
    · exact ha x hx
  have hn := (negate_decode (before++after) hc).2
  simp only [rebalance,List.map_append,List.map_cons,List.sum_append,List.sum_cons] at *
  rw [hn]
  abel
#print axioms rebalance_decode_sum

theorem audit_zero (before after : List word)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ before, canonical x) (ha : ∀ x ∈ after, canonical x) :
    fold (rebalance before after) 0=0 := by
  apply decode_injective _ 0
  · exact fold_canonical _ (rebalance_canonical before after hb ha) 0 (by unfold canonical p; decide)
  · unfold canonical p; decide
  · rw [fold_zero_decode _ (rebalance_canonical before after hb ha),rebalance_decode_sum before after hb ha]
    rfl
#print axioms audit_zero

theorem audit_branch (before after : List word)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ before, canonical x) (ha : ∀ x ∈ after, canonical x) :
    decide (fold (rebalance before after) 0≠0)=false := by
  rw [audit_zero before after hb ha]
  rfl
#print axioms audit_branch

import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Fin
set_option autoImplicit false

variable {A : Type} [AddCommGroup A]
/-- Decoded row projection of sample_mask_h1_padding followed by
balance_qm31_copy_inactive. The random cells are arbitrary. -/
def sampled {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n) (random : Fin n → A)
    (i : Fin n) : A := if active i || decide (i=d) then 0 else random i

def excludedSum {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n) (v : Fin n → A) : A :=
  ∑ i : Fin n, if !active i && decide (i≠d) then v i else 0

def balanced {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n) (v : Fin n → A)
    (i : Fin n) : A := if i=d then -excludedSum active d v else v i

def inactiveSum {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (v : Fin n → A) : A :=
  ∑ i : Fin n, if active i then 0 else v i

theorem sampled_active {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n)
    (random : Fin n → A) (i : Fin n) (hi : active i=true) :
    sampled active d random i=0 := by simp [sampled,hi]
#print axioms sampled_active

theorem balanced_active {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n)
    (random : Fin n → A) (hd : active d=false) (i : Fin n) (hi : active i=true) :
    balanced active d (sampled active d random) i=0 := by
  have hid : i≠d := by intro h; subst i; rw [hd] at hi; contradiction
  simp [balanced,hid,sampled_active active d random i hi]
#print axioms balanced_active

theorem balanced_sum {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n)
    (v : Fin n → A) (hd : active d=false) :
    inactiveSum active (balanced active d v)=0 := by
  classical
  have hsum : inactiveSum active (balanced active d v) =
      -excludedSum active d v + excludedSum active d v := by
    unfold inactiveSum
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ d)]
    simp only [hd, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, balanced, if_pos rfl]
    congr 1
    unfold excludedSum
    calc
      _ = ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase d, if !active i && decide (i≠d) then v i else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        have hid : i≠d := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hi).1
        cases ha : active i <;> simp [hid,ha]
      _ = _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.erase_subset d Finset.univ)
        intro i hi he
        have hid : i=d := by
          by_contra h
          exact he (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨h,hi⟩)
        subst i
        simp
  rw [hsum,neg_add_cancel]
#print axioms balanced_sum
/-- The two rejection predicates are both false for every successfully sampled
and balanced padding. No assumption is made about the random values. -/
theorem padding_guards {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n)
    (random : Fin n → A) (hd : active d=false) :
    (∀ i, active i=true → balanced active d (sampled active d random) i=0) ∧
      inactiveSum active (balanced active d (sampled active d random))=0 :=
  ⟨fun i hi => balanced_active active d random hd i hi,
    balanced_sum active d _ hd⟩
#print axioms padding_guards
end PV_L2C_PaddingProducer

theorem canonical_fold (xs : List Q) (hxs : ∀ q ∈ xs, Canonical q)
    (s : Q) (hs : Canonical s) : Canonical (foldQ xs s) := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => exact hs
  | cons q qs ih =>
    exact ih (fun q hq => hxs q (by simp [hq])) (addQ s q)
      (add_canonical s q hs (hxs q (by simp)))
#print axioms canonical_fold

theorem decode_fold (xs : List Q) (hxs : ∀ q ∈ xs, Canonical q)
    (s : Q) (hs : Canonical s) :
    decodeQ (foldQ xs s)=decodeQ s+(xs.map decodeQ).sum := by
  induction xs generalizing s with
  | nil => simp [foldQ]
  | cons q qs ih =>
    rw [foldQ,ih (fun q hq => hxs q (by simp [hq])) (addQ s q)
      (add_canonical s q hs (hxs q (by simp))),add_decode s q hs (hxs q (by simp))]
    simp [add_assoc]
#print axioms decode_fold

/-- The ascending row fold of a full fixed-length native table. -/
def tableSum {n : Nat} (table : Fin n → Q) : Q := foldQ (List.ofFn table) zero

theorem tableSum_canonical {n : Nat} (table : Fin n → Q)
    (hc : ∀ i, Canonical (table i)) : Canonical (tableSum table) := by
  apply canonical_fold _ _ zero zero_canonical
  intro q hq
  obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hq
  exact hc i
#print axioms tableSum_canonical

theorem tableSum_decode {n : Nat} (table : Fin n → Q)
    (hc : ∀ i, Canonical (table i)) :
    decodeQ (tableSum table)=∑ i : Fin n, decodeQ (table i) := by
  unfold tableSum
  rw [decode_fold _ (by intro q hq; obtain ⟨i,rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hq; exact hc i) zero zero_canonical]
  simp [zero_decode,List.map_ofFn,List.sum_ofFn]
#print axioms tableSum_decode

/-- Active rows are public. Their source step skips addition. This table
projection inserts zero at exactly those rows; native canonical add-zero is
proved below rather than assumed to be raw modular normalization. -/
def inactiveTable {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (table : Fin n → Q) : Fin n → Q :=
  fun i => if active i then zero else table i

theorem inactive_canonical {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (table : Fin n → Q)
    (hc : ∀ i, Canonical (table i)) : ∀ i, Canonical (inactiveTable active table i) := by
  intro i
  cases hi : active i <;> simp [inactiveTable,hi,zero_canonical,hc i]
#print axioms inactive_canonical

theorem inactive_decode {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (table : Fin n → Q)
    (hc : ∀ i, Canonical (table i)) :
    decodeQ (tableSum (inactiveTable active table))=
      PV_L2C_PaddingProducer.inactiveSum active (fun i => decodeQ (table i)) := by
  rw [tableSum_decode _ (inactive_canonical active table hc)]
  unfold PV_L2C_PaddingProducer.inactiveSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  cases ha : active i <;> simp [inactiveTable,ha,zero_decode]
#print axioms inactive_decode

theorem native_add_zero (s : Q) (hs : Canonical s) : addQ s zero=s := by
  apply decode_injective _ _ (add_canonical s zero hs zero_canonical) hs
  rw [add_decode s zero hs zero_canonical,zero_decode,add_zero]
#print axioms native_add_zero
end PV_L2C_QFold

  have h := congrArg (fun n : Nat => (n : ZMod p)) (Nat.mod_add_div x (p+1))

  rw [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_mul,hr,one_mul] at h
  simpa only [fold31,Nat.cast_add] using h

  have h := second_bound x hx

/-! Exact word-byte bridge via a pure BitVec lemma. No scalar-byte simp
procedure participates in the bit-level arithmetic proof. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitWordBytes47
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec

def rawByte (x : U8) : AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec.Byte := x.bv.toFin
def rawWord (x : U32) : RawWord := x.bv.toFin

def bits (w : BitVec 32) : WordBytes := fun i =>
  (w.toLEBytes[i.val]'(by simpa only [BitVec.toLEBytes_length] using i.isLt)).toFin

theorem bits_decode (w : BitVec 32) : decodeWordLE (bits w)=w.toFin := by
  apply Fin.ext
  have hw := w.isLt
  simp [decodeWordLE,bits,BitVec.toLEBytes,BitVec.toNat_setWidth,BitVec.toNat_ushiftRight,
    Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  omega

theorem bits_word (w : BitVec 32) : w.toLEBytes.map BitVec.toFin=
    List.ofFn (encodeWordLE w.toFin) := by
  have hc : encodeWordLE w.toFin=bits w := by
    rw [← bits_decode w]
    exact encodeWordLE_decodeWordLE _
  rw [hc]
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp only [List.length_map,BitVec.toLEBytes_length,List.length_ofFn]
  · intro i hi hj
    simp only [List.getElem_map,List.getElem_ofFn,bits]

theorem word (x : U32) : (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes x).val.map rawByte=
    List.ofFn (encodeWordLE (rawWord x)) := by
  change (x.bv.toLEBytes.map (@UScalar.mk .U8)).map rawByte = _
  rw [List.map_map]
  exact bits_word x.bv

#print axioms bits_decode
#print axioms bits_word
#print axioms word
end R1Z.ProverCommitWordBytes47

/-- The real scalar byte primitives, rather than a codec-success premise. -/
theorem word_roundtrip (x : U32) :
    core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes x)=x := by
  let bs := AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE (R1Z.ProverCommitWordBytes47.rawWord x)
  have raw_eq : R1Z.ProverCommitWordBytes47.rawByte=AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeByte := by
    funext b
    apply Fin.ext
    rfl
  have hb : (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes x).val.map AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeByte=
      List.ofFn bs := by
    simpa only [raw_eq] using R1Z.ProverCommitWordBytes47.word x
  have injective : Function.Injective AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeByte := by
    intro a b h
    rw [← AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.word_roundtrip a,
      ← AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.word_roundtrip b,h]
  have hs : (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes x).val=
      [AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.encodeByte (bs 0),
       AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.encodeByte (bs 1),
       AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.encodeByte (bs 2),
       AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.encodeByte (bs 3)] := by
    apply (List.map_inj_right (fun a b h => injective h)).mp
    rw [hb]
    simp only [List.map_cons,List.map_nil,AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.byte_roundtrip]
    rfl
  have ha : core.num.U32.to_le_bytes x=Array.make 4#usize
      [AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.encodeByte (bs 0),
       AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.encodeByte (bs 1),
       AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.encodeByte (bs 2),
       AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.encodeByte (bs 3)] := Subtype.ext hs
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  rw [ha]
  change (AspisR1.AeneasWordCodec.aeneasWord bs).val=x.val
  rw [AspisR1.AeneasWordCodec.aeneasWord_val_eq]
  change (AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec.decodeWordLE
    (AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE (R1Z.ProverCommitWordBytes47.rawWord x))).val=x.val
  rw [AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec.decodeWordLE_encodeWordLE]
  rfl
#print axioms word_roundtrip

/-- The actual extracted native >=P branch takes its accepting arm. -/
theorem scalar_parse (x : U32) (hx : x.val<2147483647) :
    aspis_core.field.M31.from_le_bytes (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes x)=ok (some x) := by
  have h : ¬ x≥aspis_core.field.P := by
    unfold aspis_core.field.P
    scalar_tac
  unfold aspis_core.field.M31.from_le_bytes
  rw [word_roundtrip]
  change (if x≥aspis_core.field.P then ok none else ok (some x))=ok (some x)
  rw [if_neg h]
#print axioms scalar_parse
end PV_L2C_CanonicalParser

def without {n : Nat} (d : Fin n) (table : Fin n → Q) : Fin n → Q :=
  fun i => if i=d then zero else table i

def excluded {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n) (table : Fin n → Q) : Q :=
  tableSum (inactiveTable active (without d table))

def rebalance {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n) (table : Fin n → Q) : Fin n → Q :=
  fun i => if i=d then subQ zero (excluded active d table) else table i

def sample {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n) (random : Fin n → Q) : Fin n → Q :=
  fun i => if active i || decide (i=d) then zero else random i

theorem without_canonical {n : Nat} (d : Fin n) (table : Fin n → Q)
    (hc : ∀ i, Canonical (table i)) : ∀ i, Canonical (without d table i) := by
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i=d <;> simp [without,hi,zero_canonical,hc i]
#print axioms without_canonical

theorem excluded_canonical {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n) (table : Fin n → Q)
    (hc : ∀ i, Canonical (table i)) : Canonical (excluded active d table) :=
  tableSum_canonical _ (inactive_canonical active _ (without_canonical d table hc))
#print axioms excluded_canonical

theorem rebalance_canonical {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n) (table : Fin n → Q)
    (hc : ∀ i, Canonical (table i)) : ∀ i, Canonical (rebalance active d table i) := by
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i=d
  · simp only [rebalance,hi,if_pos]
    exact sub_canonical _ _ zero_canonical (excluded_canonical active d table hc)
  · simpa [rebalance,hi] using hc i
#print axioms rebalance_canonical

theorem excluded_decode {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n) (table : Fin n → Q)
    (hc : ∀ i, Canonical (table i)) :
    decodeQ (excluded active d table)=excludedSum active d (fun i => decodeQ (table i)) := by
  rw [excluded,inactive_decode active _ (without_canonical d table hc)]
  unfold inactiveSum excludedSum
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  by_cases hid : i=d <;> cases ha : active i <;> simp [without,hid,ha,zero_decode]
#print axioms excluded_decode

theorem rebalance_decode {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n) (table : Fin n → Q)
    (hc : ∀ i, Canonical (table i)) (i : Fin n) :
    decodeQ (rebalance active d table i)=balanced active d (fun i => decodeQ (table i)) i := by
  by_cases hi : i=d
  · simp only [rebalance,hi,if_pos,balanced]
    rw [sub_decode _ _ zero_canonical (excluded_canonical active d table hc),
      zero_decode,zero_sub,excluded_decode active d table hc]
  · simp [rebalance,balanced,hi]
#print axioms rebalance_decode

/-- Actual four-limb inactive sum is raw zero after the negative-sum store,
for arbitrary canonical prior values and arbitrary public inactive geometry. -/
theorem raw_sum_zero {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n) (table : Fin n → Q)
    (hc : ∀ i, Canonical (table i)) (hd : active d=false) :
    tableSum (inactiveTable active (rebalance active d table))=zero := by
  have hcan := rebalance_canonical active d table hc
  apply decode_injective _ _ (tableSum_canonical _ (inactive_canonical active _ hcan)) zero_canonical
  rw [inactive_decode active _ hcan,zero_decode]
  have he : (fun i => decodeQ (rebalance active d table i))=
      balanced active d (fun i => decodeQ (table i)) := by
    funext i
    exact rebalance_decode active d table hc i
  rw [he]
  exact balanced_sum active d _ hd
#print axioms raw_sum_zero

theorem sample_canonical {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n) (random : Fin n → Q)
    (hc : ∀ i, Canonical (random i)) : ∀ i, Canonical (sample active d random i) := by
  intro i
  unfold sample
  split <;> simp_all [zero_canonical]
#print axioms sample_canonical

theorem active_zero {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n) (random : Fin n → Q)
    (hd : active d=false) (i : Fin n) (hi : active i=true) :
    rebalance active d (sample active d random) i=zero := by
  have hid : i≠d := by intro h; subst i; rw [hd] at hi; contradiction
  simp [rebalance,sample,hid,hi]
#print axioms active_zero

/-- N2's two native rejection predicates, with no zero-sum hypothesis. -/
theorem guard_outcomes {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Fin n) (random : Fin n → Q)
    (hc : ∀ i, Canonical (random i)) (hd : active d=false) :
    (∀ i, (active i && decide (rebalance active d (sample active d random) i≠zero))=false) ∧
    decide (tableSum (inactiveTable active (rebalance active d (sample active d random)))≠zero)=false := by
  constructor
  · intro i
    cases hi : active i with
    | false => simp [hi]
    | true => rw [active_zero active d random hd i hi]; simp
  · rw [raw_sum_zero active d _ (sample_canonical active d random hc) hd]
    rfl
#print axioms guard_outcomes
end PV_L2C_PaddingNative

namespace PV_L2C_SparseFold
open PV_L2C_NativeQ PV_L2C_QBalance PV_L2C_QFold
/-- Literal native loop step: active rows skip field addition. -/
def run {I : Type} (active : I → Bool) (table : I → Q) : List I → Q → Q
 | [],s => s
 | i::is,s => run active table is (if active i then s else addQ s (table i))

theorem dense_projection {I : Type} (active : I → Bool) (table : I → Q)
    (rows : List I) (hc : ∀ i ∈ rows, Canonical (table i))
    (s : Q) (hs : Canonical s) :
    run active table rows s=
      foldQ (rows.map (fun i => if active i then zero else table i)) s := by
  induction rows generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i is ih =>
    have htail : ∀ i ∈ is, Canonical (table i) := fun i hi => hc i (by simp [hi])
    cases ha : active i with
    | false =>
      simp only [run,ha,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,List.map_cons,foldQ]
      exact ih htail _ (add_canonical s (table i) hs (hc i (by simp)))
    | true =>
      simp only [run,ha,if_true,List.map_cons,foldQ,native_add_zero s hs]
      exact ih htail _ hs
#print axioms dense_projection

/-- ofFn id lists rows 0,...,n-1; there is no concrete 1024-cell reduction. -/
def sum {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (table : Fin n → Q) : Q :=
  run active table (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => i)) zero

theorem source_sum {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (table : Fin n → Q)
    (hc : ∀ i, Canonical (table i)) :
    sum active table=tableSum (inactiveTable active table) := by
  unfold sum
  rw [dense_projection active table _ (by
    intro i hi
    exact hc i) zero zero_canonical]
  simp only [List.map_ofFn,tableSum,inactiveTable,Function.comp_def]
  rfl
#print axioms source_sum
end PV_L2C_SparseFold

import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Fin

namespace PV_L2C_FirstInactive
/-- Literal first_inactive_row scan: None records the public all-active panic
case, rather than silently installing a successful selector. -/
def first : List Bool → Option Nat
 | [] => none
 | false::_ => some 0
 | true::xs => (first xs).map Nat.succ

theorem returned (xs : List Bool) (i : Nat) (h : first xs=some i) :
    i<xs.length ∧ xs[i]?=some false := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp [first] at h
  | cons b bs ih =>
    cases b with
    | false =>
      simp only [first,Option.some.injEq] at h
      subst i
      exact ⟨by simp, rfl⟩
    | true =>
      cases ht : first bs with
      | none => simp [first,ht] at h
      | some j =>
        simp only [first,ht,Option.map_some,Option.some.injEq] at h
        subst i
        obtain ⟨hb,hv⟩ := ih j ht
        exact ⟨by simpa using Nat.succ_lt_succ hb,by simpa using hv⟩
#print axioms returned

theorem table_returned {n : Nat} (active : Fin n → Bool) (d : Nat)
    (h : first (List.ofFn active)=some d) : ∃ hd : d<n, active ⟨d,hd⟩=false := by
  obtain ⟨hb,hv⟩ := returned (List.ofFn active) d h
  have hd : d<n := by simpa using hb
  refine ⟨hd,?_⟩
  have he : (List.ofFn active)[d]?=some (active ⟨d,hd⟩) := by simp [hd]
  rw [he] at hv
  exact Option.some.inj hv
#print axioms table_returned
end PV_L2C_FirstInactive
